own_solution.law: Hydrostatics: P = P_surface + rho g h

defect_reasons.failed_transformation_identity: For the R sentences T7DFA and TADA3 the wiring says the surface pressure becomes p0 + q, but the certified answers (256.6, 246.6, 226.6 kPa for q = 10, 20, 40 kPa) are p0 - q + rho g h; the correct answers are 276.6, 286.6 and 306.6 kPa.

counterexamples: T7DFA / TADA3 at q = 20 kPa: p = 100 + 20 + 850*9.8*20/1000 = 120 + 166.6 = 286.6 kPa, not the certified 246.6 kPa.
q = 10 kPa: correct 276.6 kPa vs certified 256.6 kPa; q = 40 kPa: correct 306.6 kPa vs certified 226.6 kPa.
notes: Pass 2 agrees with pass 1 (pass 1 gave 286.6 kPa for both R sentences). Base answer 266.6 kPa, the D claims for the tyre and football (266.6 kPa at all q) and the C claims for both area sentences (266.6 kPa at all A) are correct, and the minimal pairs (T9F45/T7DFA and TB5A2/TADA3) share the same number and unit, differing in attachment and some verb wording only. The cancellation relation m = rho A h strictly assumes a uniform cross-section; for TDCA5 ('flat base') the tank need not be uniform, but hydrostatic pressure is independent of vessel shape, so the C stratum and answers still hold. The sign error in the R answers is the only defect, but it makes the certified answers wrong.
